title: Cup with Wreaths
acquisition: Inscription metadata from official Walters art.csv export. Image from Walters donation to Wikimedia Commons. Longer artwork descriptions excluded.
original_inscription_field: [Inscription, Greek; mold-made ] ΛΑΒΕ ΤΗΝ ΝΕΙΚΗΝ [Transliteration] Labe ten neiken [Translation] Take the victory
geography: Roman-period glass with Greek inscription; exact findspot not supplied.
provenance: Dikran Kelekian, Paris and New York, [date and mode of acquisition unknown]; Henry Walters, Baltimore, 1925, by purchase; Walters Art Museum, 1931, by bequest.
coverage_evidence: Museum supplies the full short victory formula around the glass. Description notes a reversed N in the mold; the published normalized Greek is retained.
visual_observation: One side of amber glass cup photographed. Raised letters in central band visible, but wraparound wording continues beyond this view. Rim chip, crack, surface deposits and translucent glare.
